title: One Roadside Benefit per Breakdown — Out-of-Area Tows
content:
Under Road Hazard Protection, an out-of-area tow that follows a Crestline roadside dispatch for the same breakdown shares one roadside benefit with it.

**Tow breakdown limit.** The dispatch of the same breakdown is the certificate's most recent claim entry by service date when that entry is a Crestline roadside service entry whose service date is no more than 30 days (the plan's receipt window) before the reimbursement date, and the tow is booked under that dispatch's claim number, while a tow with no such dispatch on file opens a new claim number of its own. When that dispatch was a flat-tire change, the amount paid on that dispatch's claim number is deducted from the out-of-area tow reimbursement, the breakdown receiving one roadside benefit in all; when that dispatch was a tow, the out-of-area tow reimbursement is kept within the plan's tow cap less the amount paid on that Crestline tow's claim number, the breakdown receiving one tow cap in all; when there is no such dispatch, nothing is deducted and no such limit applies.

| Certificate's most recent claim entry by service date | Claim number of the tow | Effect on the out-of-area tow reimbursement |
|---|---|---|
| Crestline flat-tire change dispatch, within 30 days | that dispatch's | the amount paid on that claim number is deducted |
| Crestline tow dispatch, within 30 days | that dispatch's | kept within the tow cap less the amount paid on that claim number |
| any other entry, a dispatch older than 30 days, or no entry | a new claim number | nothing deducted, no such limit |

**Hypothetical cases (tow cap 100.00).** A flat-tire change paid 60.00 eight days earlier and still the latest claim entry: 60.00 is deducted, under its claim number. A Crestline tow paid 70.00 five days earlier: the reimbursement is kept within 30.00. A flat-tire change 8 days earlier followed by a later repair entry: the latest entry is not a roadside service, so nothing is deducted and the tow opens a new claim number.
